g.text: Ctune (C7/8) = 2/((2*PI*13.56MHz)^2*La) La is inductance of NFC antenna La=1.5uH, Ctune=~{180pF La=2.0uH,} Ctune=~{130pF}
Close JP2 & JP3 if you're attaching an NFC antenna.
Open JP1 to disable powering the nRF52832 via a 3.3V FTDI Basic
Cut JP6 to disable the power LED.
JP4 and JP5 enable the RTC on pins 00 and 01.
